accepted_changes.name: post_ko_prism_munkidori_tempo
accepted_changes.behavior: After a forced promotion, if no offered Pokemon attacks now, manual attachment is unused, Prism Energy is visible, and a one-Dark Munkidori becomes immediately Mind Bend-ready with Prism, promote Munkidori.

accepted_changes.behavior: After selecting Retreat, keep a same-turn follow-up flag and make a legal Impidimp/Morgrem attack instead of END after all productive setup actions are exhausted; disabled against Crustle and while Confused.
